summary: A Depth subscription across a dropped socket: the reconnect logs in and subscribes again, the old connection's book is not shown again, and the first depth packet after it is the book.

notes: Web defect not expressible as a deviation (the desktop sends nothing): after a reconnect the web keeps _depth_cache (only _symbol_state is cleared, kotak_adapter.py:997), so the touch line at script line 14 republishes the previous connection's book as current.

deviations.reason: The web's Kotak adapter puts no mode in data; the desktop sends the label (ltp, quote, full). The key follows the broker's web adapter; set in the per-broker dialect entry (lane wire) in Phase B.
The web's Kotak adapter sends oi only; the desktop sends open_interest beside it. The key follows the broker's web adapter; set in the per-broker dialect entry (lane wire) in Phase B.
The web sends the packet's own net change percent (nc) as percent_change for every scrip; the desktop's carrier keeps a change only for an index, so an equity or a derivative frame has none.
The web's Kotak depth frame also names the book total totalbuyqty; the desktop's Kotak dialect does not send that name.
The web's Kotak depth frame also names the book total totalsellqty; the desktop's Kotak dialect does not send that name.
